rows.findings: Verified clean ROOT HEAD bfbabf30d53ff2ba1dc5996a693abf2b7d16c2ff and live Vite serving PID 1279608/cwd ROOT. Independently exercised Facility → Heat at 1440×900 and 430×932 on AMD hardware WebGL. Actual mounted materials: two supply mains #28d8ff; two return mains #ffb347; two see-through buried return trunks. Contexts remained live and independent probe reported no console errors. Inspected my own full screenshots and close-ups. Scoped unit checks: 34 passed. Existing mounted Heat journeys: 2 passed, 0 skipped, 0 unexpected. Build passed in HeatMainsColour worktree at the exact assigned HEAD. Inspected complete diffs of bfbabf30d and recovered colour implementation 04c7c286436ca2443a675c19b8ba09c93b141629; neither edits requirements. Both commits are ancestors of assigned HEAD. For visual comparison, recovered baseline 7e7e9db59fda7cfea6217a7baf4c7be583b01606 from the actual colour fix's parent, built it in a disposable detached worktree and verified serving PID 1353912/cwd before capture. Same fresh AI Project state, route, frozen motion, viewport and crop rectangles in each pair. No introduced collateral defect observed. Narrow default-camera mains are small; actual material assertions independently establish their colours. All browser captures were headless; independent probe omitted --hide-scrollbars. Baseline worktree removed; owned server PIDs 1353912 and 1279608 stopped with kill. No product edits, commits or pushes. Failed exploratory CLI runs and the initial ambiguous-selector probe were superseded by the successful independent hardware probe, not counted as acceptance evidence.
